description: This file contains functions and classes related to checking and formatting the status of channels and gateway connectivity in a communication system, including handling configuration and runtime interactions.

methods.name: appendEnabledConfiguredLinkedBits
methods.description: Appends status bits related to enabled, configured, and linked state of an account.

methods.name: appendModeBit
methods.description: Appends the mode of an account to the bits array.

methods.name: appendTokenSourceBits
methods.description: Appends token source information to the bits array.

methods.name: appendBaseUrlBit
methods.description: Appends the base URL of an account to the bits array.

methods.name: buildChannelAccountLine
methods.description: Constructs a formatted line describing a channel account with its status bits.

methods.name: formatGatewayChannelsStatusLines
methods.description: Formats status lines for gateway-reachable channel status payload.

methods.name: formatConfigChannelsStatusLines
methods.description: Formats status lines based on configuration snapshot when gateway is unreachable.

methods.name: channelsStatusCommand
methods.description: Main command function to check channel status, handle errors, and output results.
